title: High-performance 2D MoTe2-based photodetectors with superior Vis-NIR detection capability
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24272-24279
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00257A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xin Wang, Qingyu Zhou, Junkai Shen, Lin Lin, Hailing Tu, Guohu Zhang
This work explores 2H-MoTe2-based FETs. An optimized 2D MoTe2 photodetector and a MoTe2/MoSe2 heterojunction both exhibit excellent photodetection performance, highlighting the promise of MoTe2-based devices for Vis-NIR photodetection.
